blocks.x: Omnichannel Retail in Retail & Consumer Goods — an Achala sector brief. pricing, availability and experience decisions repeat thousands of times a day, per store This page maps the workflows, systems of record and Achala capabilities that apply here.

Achala covers Omnichannel Retail through the retail & consumer goods program stack: Achala builds pricing, assortment and store-operations decision systems under PCI DSS — decisions per store, per day, measured on margin. The capability pages below take you one level deeper.
What the operations floor feels every week
named from the floor, not from a framework, Omnichannel Retail edition:

items: Forecasts update weekly while baskets shift daily; markdowns and stockouts both inherit the lag.
Store/DC allocation on legacy rules; phantom availability coexists with overstock.
OOS and planogram drift discovered at audit; camera estates idle.
Consent and profiling governance is not yet defined; personalization ships as generic segments.
Trading peaks break cost and reliability models; P95 cost per order unknown.
Account takeover drains points and trust; controls static.
